title: Unified Return Control and MPV EOF Recovery

implementation_notes.return_service: NEW - Provides return_to_dashboard(reason, source), records last return, stops active mode via ModeSwitcher.request_stop(), includes Xbox B long‑press listener with configurable duration.
implementation_notes.keys2mpv_modified: ADDED - Ctrl+Alt+Backspace listener to trigger return_to_dashboard(reason="keyboard_shortcut", source="ctrl_alt_backspace").
implementation_notes.player_modified: UPDATED - mpv_auto_return_on_eof now saves resume memory then calls return_to_dashboard(reason="eof", source="mpv_eof").
implementation_notes.tui_modified: ADDED - In on_mount, after setting mode_switcher, calls return_service.set_mode_switcher and return_service.start_xbox_listener().
implementation_notes.webserver_modified: ADDED - Import return_service and POST /return endpoint that calls return_to_dashboard with reason/source from JSON body. Added WebUI settings section in System/Terminal panel with CZ/EN translations for keyboard shortcut, Xbox B hold, duration, last return display.
next_steps: Hook process‑exit/crash paths (SIGTERM/SIGINT in mode_switcher) to record reason/source via return_service.
Perform live verification of MPV EOF, keyboard, and Xbox return across all modes.
